dedupe_keys.name: ice database inventory of carbon and energy educational v5 0

description: The Inventory of Carbon and Energy, the ICE Database, is an embodied energy and embodied carbon database for building and construction materials published by Circular Ecology, which reports more than 100,000 users. The current free edition is the ICE Database Educational, version 5.0 of June 2026, downloaded through a form; it is restricted to education, such as teaching, student exercises, presentations, training courses and browsing the data, and must not be used for project calculations, carbon assessments, tools, software, reporting or business activity, for which the paid IC+ database is offered. The page explains embodied carbon boundaries from cradle to gate, to site and to grave, and notes that embodied carbon is often 20 to 50% of a building's whole-life carbon. Coverage: construction and building materials. Access: spreadsheet download after a form. Licence: educational-only terms; commercial use needs IC+. Caveats: values are generic averages, not product-specific EPDs. Simulation uses are teaching and first-pass embodied carbon estimates in building LCA. Related records: ÖKOBAUDAT, INIES and EC3.
